purpose: Small-map expert tuning and independent continuous-lap verification; no BC training or real-vehicle commands.

import_record.layout_note: Original train/val folders flattened into simulator maps directory; split membership preserved by original manifest and train_maps.txt/val_maps.txt.

selection.rule: Exclude candidates with any screening failure; compare two fastest candidates across all 480 training maps. Freeze fastest passing setting before val verification.

final_verification.validation_candidate_label_note: The runner default name baseline in val results refers to the explicitly supplied NEW frozen experiment_small_maps_6mps.yaml, not the previous expert.

completion_rule: Preserve state and commands between laps. Require full net forward centerline length per lap. Collision has priority over lap completion; enforce timeouts and finite-state checks.

findings.issue: Legacy finish-zone termination can fire on narrow maps after only a small part of a lap.
findings.resolution: New evaluator uses full forward progress; continuous GA77 preview completes three real laps. Existing simulator and legacy collector termination logic have not been rewritten.

findings.issue: Renderer swapped height/width and used height to calculate width scale on rectangular maps.
findings.resolution: Corrected resize dimensions and pixels-per-unit; rectangular/square geometry regression tests pass. Physics unchanged.

limitations: Finite simulation verification; not a guarantee for unseen real tracks or all initial conditions.
Friction and randomized longitudinal response remain simulation assumptions, not measured real-vehicle limits.
No VESC electrical faults, battery regeneration limits or calibrated real steering dynamics simulated.
6 m/s is an upper bound, not a constant speed or the global lap-time optimum.
Validation maps were scored only after train-only parameter selection and were not used to adjust parameters.
No imitation dataset collected and no neural-network weights changed. Future collection must support these map lists and the same full-progress completion rule.
next_step: Implement verified complete-lap label collection for the 480 training maps using this expert and completion rule; keep val maps out of training labels.
